description: This is a Java source file defining the ShoppingCartItem entity class, which models an item within a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It includes attributes such as product details, quantity, price, and associations with other entities like ShoppingCart and ShoppingCartAttributeItem.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item in a shopping cart, including product details, quantity, pricing, and auditing information.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this shopping cart item.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this shopping cart item.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of this shopping cart item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this shopping cart item.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of the shopping cart item, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the set of attributes associated with this item.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the item.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Gets the final price of the item.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the item in the cart.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the item.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart this item belongs to.

methods.name: setShoppingCart
methods.description: Associates this item with a specific shopping cart.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product's ID associated with this cart item.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Retrieves the product ID.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with this shopping cart item.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the Product object associated with this item.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds an attribute item to the shopping cart item.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes an attribute item from the shopping cart item.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Clears all attribute items from the cart item.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for this item.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Gets the subtotal amount for this item.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price details for the item.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the final price details.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if the item is marked as obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks the item as obsolete or not.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.
